name: Kryon widgets
methodology: Two frames per entry: public widget layout, interaction and paint-command generation. Deterministic monospace metrics and a recording paint host consume payloads. Pixel rasterization, system fonts and OS I/O are excluded. Sessions are retained between calls; each scenario verifies its behavior and returns zero on success. Symmetric 1.5×IQR filtering excludes outliers from the median; raw samples and excluded indices are retained.

sample_statistics.rule: Tukey 1.5×IQR fences; linearly interpolated inclusive quartiles; both tails; raw samples retained
